environment.profile: Cargo dev-test; own code opt-level 1, dependencies opt-level 3

workload: Sequential private synthetic stereo 44.1kHz WAVs; 30/180/1200 seconds, three repetitions. Short processing uses the first three seconds; LUFS full uses all frames. Reference then candidate in the same compiled test binary.

reference.note: Sequential synthetic stereo 44.1kHz float WAV. Native test-process RSS includes mmap pages/allocator retention; it is not PCM heap or WebView memory. Uncontended real Mutex; command-equivalent phases exclude IPC/UI and queue delay.

candidate.note: Sequential synthetic stereo 44.1kHz float WAV. Native test-process RSS includes mmap pages/allocator retention; it is not PCM heap or WebView memory. Uncontended real Mutex; command-equivalent phases exclude IPC/UI and queue delay.

limitations: Lock measurements use a real, uncontended Mutex around command-equivalent audio preparation and commit. IPC/UI, worker queue delay, state DTO construction and JSON serialization are excluded. These are not contention percentiles or complete command latency.

Both implementations still materialize the same owned PCM processing input; the candidate allocates/copies it on the worker, not under the session lock. This change does not establish reduced peak memory or faster DSP.

Candidate worker time also includes applying the rendered op to immutable audio. Reference worker time excludes that work, which is inside its commit lock. Compare total phase time when evaluating overall speed.
sysinfo macOS memory uses proc_taskinfo.pti_resident_size. RSS includes mapped PCM pages, caches and retained allocator pages; it is neither PCM heap size nor physical footprint.

RSS is sampled at phase boundaries, not continuously. Measurements can miss transient peaks and depend on allocation/page retention across cases. Do not sum native storage accounting, process RSS and WebView memory.
No audio device, user audio, database, model inference or WebView is used by this native benchmark.
Only three observations per scenario on one machine; these do not establish cross-platform performance or real-world interactive latency.

verification.differentialCases: Mono/stereo fragmented LUFS and stretch, markers/loop retiming, shared-snapshot undo/redo, stale edit/undo/reopened session, invalid bounds
verification.note: Large upstream model download/inference tests remain opt-in and were not rerun.
